title: The World According to Garp
author: John Irving
summary: The son of an outspoken nurse who became a feminist icon grows up to become a writer and wrestler. His family life is a stream of comic misadventures, accidents and tragedies.
readIf: you like sprawling, outrageous family novels that swing between farce and grief.
skipIf: you want a gentle book, as the humour often arrives alongside sudden, shocking events.

pairings.reason: The author's other great novel, more spiritual and sentimental, with a similar mix of comedy and loss.
Another large American family comedy with a dark, observant edge.
A war-time comedy in which the absurd and the horrible are inseparable.
